content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I hope someone can assist with my issue. When I tried to copy a contact along with its text message in the ladder editor, I received a message saying "Only text can be copied." After that, I got an error about contacts not being connected to the power bar. I checked, and I don't see any block that isn't connected. When I use the "Go to block" function in the edit menu, a block appears that isn't visible in my ladder diagram. What I need is to delete this block, but I can't find it to remove it. Thanks for any help.
Hello [user_name], Just a reminder that this forum communicates in English. Please translate your post so all users can follow the discussion.

Using Google Translate: Hello everyone, I hope someone can help me with this problem. I tried copying a contact into a text message and received a message saying "You can only copy text." After that, I got an error saying "contacts not connected to the power bar," and upon searching, I found a block that isn’t connected. When using "Go to block" from the edit menu, it shows me a block that doesn't appear in my ladder diagram. I need to delete this block, but I can’t find it. Thank you for your help.

Hello, This behavior is known when working in ladder diagrams. When copying, pasting, deleting, or moving blocks, be sure not to copy the connection to the power line. You can fix this by converting your diagram to the function block view (FBD), correcting the errors you see there, and then switching back to ladder view. Best regards,
Thanks, my issue is resolved now. Sorry, my English is not very good. Thank you all for the help.

analysis.insight_summary: The user faced difficulties in the ladder diagram editor when attempting to copy contacts, receiving restriction and error messages about unconnected contacts. An additional challenge was the presence of a block that couldn't be found in the diagram, making deletion impossible through normal means. The recommended solution was switching to the function block view to locate and resolve the issue before returning to ladder view. This situation highlights challenges around hidden or undiscoverable blocks and clarity in error reporting within the editor.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to copy contacts within the ladder diagram editor without encountering errors and to have an intuitive way to find and remove problematic or stray blocks within their project.
